name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian
type: {E : Type u} → [TopologicalSpace E] → [AddCommMonoid E] → [Module ℝ E] → {mE : MeasurableSpace E} → MeasureTheory.Measure E → Prop
provides: A measure is Gaussian when every continuous real linear functional has a real Gaussian pushforward law; centering and a specified covariance or Cameron-Martin space are additional.
type_review: Class body, probability-measure consequence and continuous-linear pushforward results inspected with parameters; manually expanded, not compiled.

name: RKHS
type: (𝕜 : Type u) → (H : Type v) → (X : Type w) → (V : Type z) → [RCLike 𝕜] → [NormedAddCommGroup V] → [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] → [NormedAddCommGroup H] → [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] → Type (max u v w z)
provides: An inner-product function space with an injective continuous linear map into functions and hence continuous point evaluation; completeness and association with a particular Gaussian measure require additional structure.
type_review: Class fields and section parameters inspected, including absence of a CompleteSpace field; universe upper bound shown as a manual source-level expansion, not an elaborator dump.

name: Function.Periodic
type: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → [Add α] → (α → β) → α → Prop
provides: Translation by the specified period leaves the function unchanged at every argument; the period need not be minimal or nonzero.
type_review: Definition and variable declarations inspected; vector-domain periods specialize to lattice generators; manually expanded, not compiled.
